subject: miami-cargo-crash
story_title: A cargo jet overran Miami's runway, struck vehicles, and killed five people on the ground

sub_events.label: Runway overrun at Miami International Airport

records.title: FAA post on 21 Air Flight 7598
records.quote: 21 Air Flight 7598 overran the runway after landing at Miami International Airport around 2 p.m. local time on Sunday, Sept. 6.
records.about: The FAA's Sunday post naming the flight, the airplane type, the origin in San Juan, and that the agency would investigate.

records.title: NTSB go-team announcement
records.quote: NTSB has launched a go team to investigate Sunday's runway excursion accident
records.about: The NTSB's Sunday post launching its investigation and naming Chairwoman Jennifer Homendy as the board member on scene.

records.title: NTSB Monday briefing notice
records.quote: NTSB will hold a media briefing today at 4 p.m. ET on the runway excursion at Miami International Airport.
records.about: The NTSB's Monday post giving the time and place of Homendy's first on-scene briefing.

records.title: NTSB wreckage-field photograph
records.quote: overran the end of Runway 30 while landing Sunday at Miami International Airport
records.about: The NTSB's Monday photograph post naming Runway 30 and 21 Air LLC Flight 7598.

records.title: Miami airport ground-stop post
records.quote: All MIA runways and taxiways are currently closed, and a full ground stop is in effect.
records.about: The airport's first Sunday post: the airplane disabled at the northwest end, every runway closed.

records.title: Miami airport one-runway update
records.quote: One runway is currently open
records.about: The airport's later Sunday post saying one runway had reopened.

records.title: Miami airport two-runway update
records.quote: Two of our four runways are currently open
records.about: The airport's Sunday evening post saying two of four runways were open.

records.title: Miami-Dade Fire Rescue incident update 1
records.quote: Over 60 Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units are on scene of an incident involving a plane that overran a runway and struck multiple vehicles
records.about: The fire department's 3:25 p.m. Sunday update: more than 60 units, the airplane on fire.

records.title: Miami-Dade Fire Rescue incident update 2
records.quote: MDFR transported five patients to local area hospitals.
records.about: The fire department's 6:25 p.m. Sunday update: 200 personnel, foam on an engine fire, one person extricated from under a vehicle, five patients taken to hospitals.

records.title: 21 Air statement on the Miami accident
records.quote: We are devastated by the accident involving one of our aircraft in Miami on 09/06.
records.about: The operator's website statement, signed by chief executive Keith Winters, cooperating with the NTSB and FAA.

records.title: C-SPAN page for the NTSB Miami briefing
records.quote: NTSB Officials Hold Briefing on Deadly Amazon Prime Plane Crash in Miami
records.about: C-SPAN's page for the Monday briefing video. The saved page names the briefing; it does not include a transcript of what was said.

records.title: 5 dead, 5 injured after Amazon cargo plane overruns runway
records.quote: Five people are dead and five people are injured
records.about: ABC's Sunday story quoting Mayor Daniella Levine Cava on the death and injury counts, and quoting the FAA statement.

records.title: Five dead after Amazon-branded cargo plane overruns runway
records.quote: Three people are in critical condition
records.about: NBC's Sunday story quoting the sheriff, the fire chief, and Amazon's spokesperson.

records.title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
records.quote: the plane, operated by Amazon, overran the runway
records.about: NPR's Sunday story quoting the sheriff, the FAA, and the aviation department.

records.title: At least 5 dead after Amazon cargo plane barreled off runway
records.quote: too soon to determine whether the people who died were on board the plane or in the vehicles
records.about: PBS reprint of the Associated Press Sunday story, including the local officials' warning that it was too soon to say who had died.

records.title: Amazon cargo plane crash victims were in vehicles that were hit, NTSB says
records.quote: In total, the plane traveled about 1,300 feet past the paved surface
records.about: CBS's Monday story from Homendy's briefing: 1,300 feet, the van and the Toyota, both recorders recovered.

records.title: Investigators recover black boxes from cargo plane crash in Miami
records.quote: The two people aboard the plane, the pilot and co-pilot, survived
records.about: Reuters Monday story from Homendy's briefing, including the 1,300-foot figure and both people on the airplane surviving.

records.title: Crashed Amazon cargo jet struck two vehicles, ended up 1,300 feet past runway, NTSB says
records.quote: 2021 white Ford Econoline van
records.about: CNBC's Monday briefing story. It matches CBS and Reuters on distance and vehicles, and gives the van year as 2021.

records.title: Feds detail plans for investigating cargo plane crash in Miami
records.quote: The Miami airport is not equipped with arresting systems
records.about: AP's Monday morning story, written before Homendy's briefing, including the EMAS note and the still-open question of whether the pilots survived.

records.title: Amazon News statement on the Miami landing
records.quote: We can confirm that an Amazon Air plane operated by 21 Air experienced an incident while attempting to land at Miami International Airport today.
records.about: Amazon News posted Kelly Nantel's Sunday statement: an Amazon Air plane operated by 21 Air.

records.title: Transportation Secretary Duffy on the Miami ground stop
records.quote: We’ve issued a full ground stop at Miami International while first responders assess the scene after an Amazon cargo plane overran the runway.
records.about: Secretary Sean Duffy's Sunday post on the ground stop and FAA inspectors.

records.title: Miami airport Monday runway update
records.quote: Two of MIA’s four runways remain closed this morning.
records.about: The airport's Monday morning post: two of four runways still closed.
